puzzles.prompt: Largest countries in the world by area
puzzles.metric: Total area including inland water, in km²

source.name: UN Statistics Division, Demographic Yearbook, Table 3

puzzles.ambiguity: Sources that rank by LAND area instead of total area place China 3rd and the United States 4th, and shift the tail. This puzzle uses total area, as stated in the metric.

puzzles.prompt: The ten most recent Best Picture winners
puzzles.metric: Academy Award for Best Picture, by ceremony year (the 89th through 98th Academy Awards)

source.name: Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences — Ceremonies

puzzles.prompt: The ten most recent Super Bowl champions
puzzles.metric: Winning team of each Super Bowl, by the calendar year the game was played.

puzzles.prompt: NFL career passing yards leaders
puzzles.metric: Most regular-season passing yards in a career, all time. Active players included.

source.name: Pro Football Reference - Career Passing Yards

puzzles.ambiguity: The ten names are stable, but their order shifts while active quarterbacks keep playing. Order here is as of the 2026 season.

puzzles.prompt: The ten most recent FIFA World Cup winners
puzzles.metric: Winner of the men's FIFA World Cup, by tournament year.

puzzles.prompt: The ten most recent NBA champions
puzzles.metric: Winner of the NBA Finals, by the year the season ended.

puzzles.prompt: The ten most recent men's Olympic 100m champions
puzzles.metric: Gold medallist in the men's Olympic 100 metres, by Games.
puzzles.ambiguity: Ben Johnson crossed first in 1988 but was disqualified for doping and the gold reassigned to Carl Lewis, which is what this puzzle uses.

puzzles.prompt: Largest economies by nominal GDP
puzzles.metric: Gross domestic product at current prices in US dollars, IMF projection for 2026
puzzles.ambiguity: Ranked by NOMINAL GDP. Measured at purchasing power parity the order differs sharply - China ranks first and India third.

puzzles.prompt: Highest mountains in the world
puzzles.metric: Elevation above sea level, in metres. Distinct peaks only, not subsidiary summits.
puzzles.ambiguity: Ranked by elevation above sea level. By prominence, or by height above base, a very different ten appears.

puzzles.prompt: Longest rivers in the world
puzzles.metric: Length in kilometres from the most distant headstream to the mouth, including named tributary systems
puzzles.ambiguity: Whether the Nile or the Amazon is longest is genuinely contested and turns on which Amazon headstream you accept. This puzzle follows Britannica in placing the Nile first.

puzzles.prompt: Largest moons in the solar system
puzzles.metric: Mean diameter in kilometres

puzzles.prompt: The ten most recent US presidents
puzzles.metric: The ten most recent people to hold the office, most recent first. Counted as people rather than terms, so anyone who served non-consecutively appears once.

puzzles.prompt: Most Super Bowl titles by franchise
puzzles.metric: Super Bowl wins, all time. A franchise keeps its wins across relocations and renamings.
puzzles.ambiguity: Several franchises are tied on wins, so the order within a tie is arbitrary; the ten clubs are what matters. NFL championships won before the Super Bowl era are not counted.

puzzles.prompt: The ten most recent NFL MVPs
puzzles.metric: The Associated Press NFL Most Valuable Player, by season.

source.name: ESPN - NFL MVP winners by year

puzzles.prompt: The ten most recent men's Olympic marathon champions
puzzles.metric: Gold medallist in the men's Olympic marathon, by Games.

puzzles.prompt: The ten most recent men's Olympic 1500m champions
puzzles.metric: Gold medallist in the men's Olympic 1500 metres, by Games.
puzzles.ambiguity: The 2008 race was won on the day by Rashid Ramzi, who was disqualified for doping; the gold went to the runner-up, which is what this puzzle uses.

puzzles.prompt: The ten most recent Champions League winners
puzzles.metric: Winner of the UEFA Champions League, by the year of the final.

puzzles.prompt: The ten most recent Premier League champions
puzzles.metric: Champion of the English Premier League, by the year the season ended.

puzzles.prompt: The ten most recent Formula 1 world champions
puzzles.metric: Winner of the Formula 1 World Drivers' Championship, by season.

puzzles.prompt: The ten most recent World Series champions
puzzles.metric: Winner of the World Series, by season.

puzzles.prompt: The ten most recent Wimbledon men's singles champions
puzzles.metric: Winner of the Wimbledon men's singles title. The 1936 to 2026 sequence skips 2020, when the championships were cancelled.

puzzles.prompt: The ten most recent Nobel laureates in Literature
puzzles.metric: Winner of the Nobel Prize in Literature, by year of award.

source.name: NobelPrize.org - all Nobel Prizes in Literature

puzzles.prompt: Largest islands in the world
puzzles.metric: Island area in km². Continental landmasses are not counted as islands.
puzzles.ambiguity: Australia is excluded as a continental landmass rather than an island; including it would put it first by a wide margin.

puzzles.prompt: Largest deserts in the world
puzzles.metric: Desert area in km², where a desert is defined by low precipitation rather than by heat. Polar deserts count.
puzzles.ambiguity: Defining deserts by aridity rather than temperature puts the two polar deserts at the top. Lists that only count hot deserts begin with the Sahara and produce a different ten.

puzzles.prompt: Most abundant elements in Earth's crust
puzzles.metric: Share of the Earth's crust by mass, as a percentage.

source.name: CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics - abundance of elements

puzzles.ambiguity: By mass, and for the crust only. The Earth as a whole is mostly iron, and by number of atoms rather than mass the order shifts.
